datasets.name: service-health
datasets.sql: select branch_id as "branchId", branch_name as "branchName", report_date as "reportDate", eligible_visit_count as "eligibleVisitCount", completed_visit_count as "completedVisitCount", total_duration_minutes as "totalDurationMinutes", duration_observation_count as "durationObservationCount", open_work_count as "openWorkCount", source_updated_at as "sourceUpdatedAt" from analytics.service_health_daily_v1 where report_date >= current_date - interval '30 days' order by report_date desc, branch_id asc
